description: Cache endpoint config reaches buckconfig, tk and runner through separate channels (TURNKEY_TEST_CACHE_ADDRESS, TURNKEY_TEST_CACHE_SERVER presence, TLS only in buckconfig). tk's probe rejects anything but grpc:// so a TLS remote reads as unusable. One descriptor emitted by Nix, checked contract at the Nix/tk seam.
title: One test cache descriptor from Nix to tk to runner
